responsibility: Contains the RX machine description that drives RTL expansion, instruction selection, scheduling, and final instruction emission for Renesas RX processors. It defines target constants and UNSPEC codes, includes the RX predicates and constraints, describes pipeline timing attributes and reservations, and supplies the insn patterns, expanders, and output templates for comparisons, moves, arithmetic, control-register operations, interrupts, builtins, PID addressing, and other RX instruction forms.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the machine-description DSL for RX instruction selection and scheduling: define_insn/define_expand patterns, UNSPEC codes, constraints includes, and pipeline reservations that describe RTL-to-assembly mappings, rather than the C/C++ target macros in rx.h, hook code in rx.cc, or command-line option declarations in rx.opt.
